entries.title: The dragging is what hurts
entries.literal_meaning: Being taken by a tiger does not hurt; the dragging hurts.
entries.explanation: The line sets being taken by a tiger beside the discomfort of being dragged. The dictionary quotes it under dragging along the ground. Our reading hears an exaggerated complaint that singles out one part of a larger ordeal. It does not measure pain or establish that the larger danger is harmless; no actual encounter or speaker is identified.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାଘ ନେବା ସହ ଭୂମିରେ ଘୋଷାରି ନେବାର କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ଭୂମିରେ ଟାଣିନେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ବଡ଼ ଦୁର୍ଦ୍ଦଶାର ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଂଶକୁ ବାଛି ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତିରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ କରାଯାଏ। ଏହା ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାର ମାପ ନୁହେଁ ବା ବଡ଼ ବିପଦ ନିରାପଦ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରକୃତ ଘଟଣା ବା ବକ୍ତା ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହୋଇନାହାନ୍ତି।
entries.english_summary: Our reading singles out one discomfort within an exaggerated ordeal.

entries.cultural_context: Exact fused ବାଘନବା remains unchanged. The quoted contrast is rhetorical, not medical or wildlife advice. Later road and laziness senses do not supply this saying’s meaning.

entries.title: One keeps; another will squander
entries.literal_meaning: The books say: one will squander; one is keeping.
entries.explanation: The saying invokes books while putting keeping beside future squandering. The dictionary’s following explanation describes one person laboriously saving wealth and another later wasting it. Our reading notices the contrast between their actions. No particular book is named or independently checked, and the line does not establish a universal family pattern or identify an heir.
entries.meaning_odia: ବହିର କଥା ଉଠାଇ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ରଖିବା ସହ ଉଡ଼ାଇବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଜଣେ କଷ୍ଟରେ ଧନ ସଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି, ପରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣେ ତାହା ଅପବ୍ୟୟ କରନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି ଦୁଇ କାମର ବିରୋଧକୁ ଦେଖେ। କେଉଁ ବହି, ଉତ୍ସ ନାମ କହେନାହିଁ; ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଯାଞ୍ଚ ମଧ୍ୟ ହୋଇନାହିଁ। ଏହା ସବୁ ପରିବାରର ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ ବା କୌଣସି ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ପରିଚୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading contrasts saving and waste, without verifying a scripture.

entries.title: Let the visits continue
entries.literal_meaning: Let the coming and going continue; let there be no hope of a handful of rice.
entries.explanation: The line wishes for continued visits while setting aside an expectation of rice. Its dictionary placement concerns frequenting a place. Our reading values contact beyond what a visit might provide. That application is editorial: the source names no particular friendship, household or exchange, and it does not require a hungry guest to deny their needs.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯିବାଆସିବା ଚାଲିଥାଉ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମୁଠିଏ ଭାତର ଆଶା ନ ଥାଉ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଏହି ଇଚ୍ଛା କହେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ବାରମ୍ବାର କୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯିବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତିର ଆଶାଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଅଲଗା କରି ଦେଖେ। ଏହା ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ; ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବନ୍ଧୁତା, ପରିବାର ବା ଦେଣନେଣ କହେନାହିଁ। ଭୋକିଲା ଅତିଥି ନିଜ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଲୁଚାଇବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading separates continued contact from an expected material return.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଯିବାଆସିବା ଓ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତିର ଆଶା ଅଲଗା ରହେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇ ବନ୍ଧୁ କିଛି ଦେବାନେବା ନ ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଖା କରୁଥିଲେ। ଦରକାର ପଡ଼ିଲେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କଥା ମଧ୍ୟ ଖୋଲାଖୋଲି କହୁଥିଲେ। / Two friends keep meeting and can also speak honestly about needing help. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The earlier Fakirmohan Galpaswalpa passage illustrates coming and going separately; it is not this saying’s authorship. No fixed hospitality custom, denial of food or duty is established.

entries.title: Six ears and a disclosed secret
entries.literal_meaning: Six ears, disclosure of the secret.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explains six ears as three people: a matter known to two reaches a third. The short saying compresses that disclosure into a phrase. Our reading notices how adding a listener changes the circle of knowledge. It does not prove that every third person spreads a secret or forbid seeking appropriate help about something troubling.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଛଅଟି କାନ ଅର୍ଥ ତିନି ଜଣ: ଦୁଇ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଗୁପ୍ତ କଥା ତୃତୀୟ ଜଣ ଜାଣନ୍ତି। ଛୋଟ ଢଗଟି ସେହି ପ୍ରକାଶକୁ ଧରେ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଆଉ ଜଣେ ଶୁଣିଲେ ଜାଣିଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପରିସର ବଦଳେ। ସବୁ ତୃତୀୟ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି କଥା ପ୍ରଚାର କରନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ଏହା ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ଚିନ୍ତାଜନକ ବିଷୟରେ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ମାଗିବାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହା ବାରଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading tracks a wider circle, not inevitable betrayal.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଜାଣିବାର ପରିସର ବଢ଼େ, ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ ଅନିବାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଯୋଜନା ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କୁ କହିବା ଆଗରୁ ସେମାନେ କଣ ଭାଗ କରିବେ ଠିକ୍ କଲେ। / Two collaborators agree what to share before inviting another into their planning. This example is invented.
